stories.title: Bolsonaro vence a Lula en primera vuelta de las elecciones y acaricia el retorno de la ultraderecha al poder en Brasil

en.title: Bolsonaro defeats Lula in first round of elections and approaches the return of the far-right to power in Brazil
en.summary: In Brazil's presidential election, the senator received 47.1% of votes compared to the incumbent leftist president's 45%. Both candidates will compete in a runoff scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro gana a Lula, pero los dos disputarán una segunda vuelta en tres semanas

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defeats Lula, but both will compete in a second round in three weeks
en.summary: A strong conservative wave brings the far-right to power in São Paulo, Rio, and the Senate in Brazil's elections. A runoff between the two candidates will be held in three weeks.

stories.title: Lula y Bolsonaro van a la segunda vuelta con un Congreso bolsonarista

en.title: Lula and Bolsonaro advance to second round with a Bolsonarist Congress
en.summary: Brazil held one of its most polarized and uncertain presidential elections. Both candidates advanced to a runoff on October 25, while the far-right gained strength in state governments and both chambers of Congress.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro desborda las encuestas y se acerca a la Presidencia de Brasil frente a Lula

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surpasses polls and approaches Brazil's presidency against Lula
en.summary: The son of the former president received stronger-than-expected support in the election nearly four years after his father's failed coup attempt. Lula faces a narrow margin and must recover results as his rival approaches victory.

stories.title: El Pentágono retira sus bombarderos de la base británica de Fairford tras el presunto intento de atentado

en.title: Pentagon withdraws its bombers from British Fairford base after alleged attack attempt
en.summary: The United States military has removed bombers from a British air base following a suspected terrorist plot. The UK suspects Iranian involvement, though Tehran denies any connection.

stories.title: La Fuerza Aérea de Estados Unidos retira todos sus bombarderos de una base aérea británica señalada como objetivo de un presunto ataque terrorista

en.title: U.S. Air Force removes all bombers from British air base targeted in alleged terrorist attack
en.summary: The U.S. military has relocated all bombers from a British base that was identified as a potential target for terrorism. The withdrawal coincides with President Trump's evaluation of military options regarding Iran.

stories.title: El PSOE espera el adelanto electoral inminente con un objetivo realista: evitar el batacazo aunque gobiernen PP y Vox

en.title: PSOE anticipates imminent early elections with realistic goal: avoid heavy defeat even if PP and Vox govern
en.summary: Spain's Socialist party prepares for early elections and aims to limit electoral losses. The party is considering strategies including housing measure validations through parliamentary procedures where they hold majority support.

stories.title: El Barça de una Claudia Pina estelar propina al Real Madrid una paliza histórica

en.title: Barcelona's outstanding Claudia Pina delivers historic thrashing to Real Madrid
en.summary: Barcelona defeated Real Madrid 7-0 at Camp Nou, with Claudia Pina scoring four of the goals in a dominant performance.

stories.title: Todo listo en el PSOE y el Gobierno para un adelanto electoral tras la derrota de los decretos en el Congreso

en.title: PSOE and Government ready for early elections following congressional decree defeat
en.summary: Following the rejection of decrees in Congress, the Spanish government and PSOE are preparing for early elections while seeking alternative approval methods.

stories.title: El póquer de Pina al Real Madrid en el clásico femenino la coloca en un club muy exclusivo

en.title: Pina's four goals against Real Madrid in women's classic places her in very exclusive club
en.summary: A forward scored four goals in the first half of a women's match between two clubs. This achievement matches the record held by only three other players historically.

stories.title: Los jóvenes ahogados en Guardamar eran una pareja de novios ucranianos: él no logró salvarla cuando fue arrastrada por las corrientes

en.title: Young people drowned in Guardamar were a Ukrainian couple of sweethearts: he could not save her when she was swept away by currents
en.summary: Two Ukrainian residents of Poland died by drowning in Guardamar after one attempted to rescue the other from strong sea currents. The couple was visiting friends in the Spanish coastal area.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa de Guardamar del Segura

en.title: Two young people drown at a beach in Guardamar del Segura
en.summary: Two individuals drowned while swimming at a beach displaying a red flag warning in Guardamar del Segura.

stories.title: BP apuesta por las flotas con una nueva plataforma para la gestión del repostaje

en.title: BP bets on fleets with a new platform for refueling management
en.summary: BP operates 700 service stations in Spain and provides access to 25,000 recharging points through a new fleet management platform.

stories.title: Macquarie busca jefe en España tras el paso atrás de Juan Caño

en.title: Macquarie seeks head in Spain after Juan Caño steps back
en.summary: Macquarie is searching for a new leader in Spain as Juan Caño transitions to an operating partner role while retaining board positions.

stories.title: Los inversores creen que Panamá superará las amenazas de Trump

en.title: Investors believe Panama will overcome Trump's threats
en.summary: Panama's bonds are performing better than expected despite threats to the country's economy from external pressures.

stories.title: Intesa eleva su oferta a Monte dei Paschi a 0,25 euros por acción

en.title: Intesa raises its offer to Monte dei Paschi to 0.25 euros per share
en.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has increased its cash offer to acquire Monte dei Paschi, raising the price to 0.25 euros per share.

stories.title: La marca hotelera Ritz elige Madrid para su aterrizaje en el negocio residencial

en.title: The Ritz hotel brand chooses Madrid for its entry into the residential business
en.summary: Madrid will host Ritz's first branded residences project, with Blasson Property and Pictet Alternative Advisors investing 150 million euros to convert a former National Court building into 29 luxury residences.
